## v1.0.0 — 2026-03-14

Version 1.0.0 introduces comprehensive platform integrations and new functionality including GitLab and Bitbucket support, Microsoft Teams and Confluence integration, Notion connectivity, hosted changelog capabilities, embeddable widgets, and usage metering systems.

### ✨ Features

- Added GitLab integration for repository management and CI/CD workflows
- Added Bitbucket integration for source code management and deployment pipelines
- Added Microsoft Teams integration for team collaboration and notifications
- Added Confluence integration for documentation and knowledge management
- Added Notion integration for workspace and content management
- Implemented hosted changelog functionality for centralized release documentation
- Added embeddable widget component for external integration
- Implemented usage metering system for tracking and analytics

v1.0.0 — 2026-03-14

Version 1.0.0 represents a major milestone release that significantly expands platform integrations and introduces comprehensive usage tracking capabilities. This release adds support for GitLab, Bitbucket, Microsoft Teams, Confluence, and Notion integrations, while introducing a hosted changelog solution, embeddable widget functionality, and usage metering system for monitoring and analytics.

✨ Features

  • Added GitLab integration support for repository management and CI/CD workflows.
  • Added Bitbucket integration support for Git repository operations and pipeline management.
  • Added Microsoft Teams integration for team collaboration and notifications.
  • Added Confluence integration for documentation and knowledge management workflows.
  • Added Notion integration for workspace and content management capabilities.
  • Introduced hosted changelog functionality for centralized release documentation management.
  • Added embeddable widget component for displaying changelog information in external applications.
  • Implemented usage metering system for tracking and monitoring platform utilization metrics.
